plain_english_revision: The amendment adds three specific private schools (Madison Academy, Briarwood Presbyterian Church School, and Briarwood Christian School) to the list of institutions authorized by law enforcement agencies in Alabama.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment supports expanding the scope of which private educational institutions are eligible for police officer employment under existing statutes.
evidence_quotes: Representative Carns: HB309 Law enforcement, schools, provide for Madison Academy, Briarwood Presbyterian Church, and Briarwood Christian School to employ police officers
